target.command:
cd /home/john/mynotes/deterministic_equidistribution_theory/c_suite/out_large
echo "### E: trivial rho0 and min gap_ratio per (Q,s) ###"
echo "Q,s,rho0,min_gap_ratio,kappa_Q(=1-min_ratio)"
grep -v '^#' spectral_gaps.csv | grep -v '^Q,L' | awk -F, '
  $6=="trivial"{rho0[$1"|"$5]=$8}
  $6!="trivial"{k=$1"|"$5; gr=$10; if(!(k in mn)||gr<mn[k])mn[k]=gr}
  END{ for(k in mn){split(k,a,"|"); printf "%s,%s,%.4f,%.4f,%.4f\n",a[1],a[2],rho0[k],mn[k],1-mn[k]}}' | sort -t, -k1,1n -k2,2n
echo
echo "### E: does the gap kappa_Q shrink as Q grows? (min over chars, per s) ###"
grep -v '^#' spectral_gaps.csv | grep -v '^Q,L' | awk -F, '
  $6!="trivial" && $5=="1.0000"{k=$1; gr=$10; if(!(k in mn)||gr<mn[k])mn[k]=gr}
  END{print "at s=1:"; for(q in mn) printf "  Q=%-4s kappa_Q=%.4f\n",q,1-mn[q]}' | sort -t= -k2 -n
